svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: The Sundering Isles
svg.desc: a chart of the broken coast, the scatter & the drowned road — generated by tools/draw-map.mjs from data/maps/sundering-isles.json. A flat terrain colour per hex, a coastline, the settlements and the lanes between them. No hex grid: that is an overlay drawn at read time from the same rows, so it cannot disagree with this.
